notes: Checked by scripts/check-budget.mjs after every npm run build. The gates and targets are DURABLE-11's (QA_DURABLE.md): boot JS and render-blocking CSS gzipped at level 9 (KB = 1000 bytes), any chunk loaded on demand, and the service worker's precache. FOLLOWUP-23 set the two first-load gates on the merged app: the teacher's, the parents' area's, the legal pages' and the saving screens' rules load with their screens, the demo class's code with the demo, and the tutor's prompts, schemas and checks (shared/ai.js and what it imports) with the tutor, the first load reading only the AI kinds and limits (shared/aiKinds.js). The build measured 403.3 KB boot JS (403.5 KB built as the public site, VITE_API_URL=none), so the ratchet set the gate to that + 5%: 424 KB, about 20 KB of room; it never goes up. CSS measured 45.5 KB (gate 46). The 260 KB and 32 KB targets stay DURABLE-11's: a warning, not a gate. lazyOnly is STUDENT-15's, and FOLLOWUP-23 added the demo class (lib/demo.js, components/DemoAsk.jsx) and the tutor's code (lib/ai.js and shared/ai.js, shared/pedagogy.js, shared/guard.js, shared/topicWays.js): these modules must never be in a boot file (scripts/vite-plugin-budget.mjs writes the module map it is read from). The stage-5 merge (functions, eq:6-7) put about 24 KB of exercise generators and tasks in the first load: the help lines moved to shared/helpLines.js so shared/safety.js and shared/blocklist.js load with the screens that read a child's words (lazyOnly names them), and the graph and protractor rules moved to styles/lazy/graph.css. Measured 420.9 KB boot JS, 45.5 KB CSS: both gates unchanged. The precache gate is not a ratchet: the merge measured 4.89 MB (the new topic's raw bytes), so it moved by the integration rule, measured + 5%, to 5.13 MB. The boot split took the exercise code off the first load: the topics' names, stairs, colours and misconception names are content/topics.gen.js (generated from the grade files by scripts/gen-content-meta.mjs, with learn/content/meta.gen.ts and the challenge tasks' meta learn/challenges/meta.gen.ts), the first screens read content/topics.js, and each topic's generators load with its teaching (content/topics.js loadGens, waited for by ensureTopics, or ensureGens for the two exams); the checkers and figure words (content/index.js, manip.js), the challenge parts (learn/challenges/all.ts) and the engines (lib/lesson.js, placement.js, exam.js, seeds.js, learn/items.ts) load with the exercise screens, whose chunks the service worker still precaches. lazyOnly names them (a name with a slash is one file's path: src/content/expr.js, not the first load's src/learn/expr.ts), and src/boot.test.js finds any generator file by its gen: before a build. Measured 420.9 -> 317.2 KB boot JS (317.3 KB built as the public site), CSS 45.5 KB, so the ratchet set the boot gate to 317.2 + 5% = 333 KB, about 16 KB of room; it never goes up. The stage-3 merge (data and probability: content/data.js, prob.js and stats2.js are generator files, lazy-only by path) measured 322.6 KB boot JS (gate 333 unchanged) and, after its two objects' rules moved from app.css to styles/lazy/data.css (imported by Simulate.jsx and Chart.jsx), 45.5 KB CSS (gate 46 unchanged); the precache measured 5.23 MB (the three topics' own bytes), so it moved by the integration rule, measured + 5%, to 5.49 MB. PKG-2 added pdf.js (pdfjs-dist, the chunk vite.config.js names pdf) and lib/pdfPages.js, which draws a PDF's pages on the device: both load only when a PDF is chosen. The classroom merge's generator files (content/signed7.js, signedItems.js, angleItems.js, angles67.js, loaded through grade7.js for the signed and angles units) are lazy-only too. The stage-2 merge (measurement: content/area.js, solid.js, circle.js and space.js are generator files; grid.js, net.js and roll.js are its three objects' rules and partial.js the note on a right value in another form: all lazy-only by path) moved its objects' rules from app.css to styles/lazy/measure.css (imported by GridShape.jsx, NetFold.jsx and CircleRoll.jsx) and the drawn choices' rules to styles/lazy/figure.css, and measured 332.9 KB boot JS, 0.1 KB under the gate. The gate did not move: the topics' lesson summaries (the guide page's key ideas, words and examples) left the first load. scripts/gen-content-meta.mjs writes them to content/lessons.gen.js instead of topics.gen.js, content/lessons.js lessonOf reads them, only screens/Topic.jsx imports it, and lazyOnly names both files. Measured 326.9 KB boot JS (the same built as the public site; gate 333 unchanged), 45.8 KB CSS (gate 46 unchanged); the precache measured 5.87 MB (the four topics' own bytes), so it moved by the integration rule, measured + 5%, to 6.16 MB. The stage-4 merge (geometry: content/transf.js, congr.js and sim.js with their generator files transf.gen.js, congr.gen.js and sim.gen.js; transform.js and proof.js are its two objects' rules and proofs.js the proofs' steps and reasons: all lazy-only by path) dropped the lane's own lazy loader (content/lazyGen.js): the three topics load through content/topics.js importGens like every other topic, and the two objects register their rules through content/manip.js registerKind when the exercise side loads. Their sheets are styles/lazy/transform.css and proof.css, imported by Transform.jsx and ProofTable.jsx. Measured 332.6 KB boot JS (gate 333 unchanged: 0.4 KB of room, so the next unit moves something off the first load before it lands), 45.9 KB CSS (gate 46 unchanged); the precache measured 6.25 MB (the three topics' own bytes), so it moved by the integration rule, measured + 5%, to 6.56 MB.
